row.proto: void Sess_LapTimes_ReportLapInvalidation_Thunk(void *lapTimes, uint8_t car, uint32_t lap, uint8_t valid)
row.notes: 5-byte jmp into .data1 body=0x14f7403b0 (plaintext in the KB file). Each caller first writes a lap record's valid key ([lapTimes+0x58][car] + index*200, index u8 +0x9c80 at most 199: valid while (u64 +0xe0 & 1) == u8 +0xd8; the 200 records of 200 bytes start at entry+0x40, so +0xd8/+0xe0 are a record's +0x98/+0xa0 and +0x9c80 is the first byte after them; Sess_LapTimes_ReportNewLapTime reads its index from u8 entry+0x38 instead, 0x142f2f7cc). For car <= 0x1f the body returns unless the lobby byte [[[[lapTimes+0x78]+0x88]+0x260]+0xf88]+0x101+car*2 equals the local machine's id (vcall +0x18 on [[..]+0x40]+0xd8); for a higher id it returns when [..+0x28] > 1. It logs LAPTIMES 'Reporting LAP INVALIDATION (%d) for vehicle Ix %d' (lap, car) and posts a message (vtable 0x1458015e0, +0x08 0x500000005, +0x10 u8 car, +0x14 u32 lap, +0x18 u8 valid) through 0x14402e500 on [lapTimes+0x90]. valid 0 follows a write that makes the record invalid (+0xd8 = ((+0xe0 & 1) == 0)), with lap = the record index: the rules update's corner cutting branch at 0x14356d8e2 ('Corner_Cutting: Invalidate Current Lap!'), Sess_Rules_InvalidateLap_Thunk's body at 0x1505c46bd and 0x1505c47d3, and Game_PracticeProgrammeSystem_BindCompareLap at 0x142941328 when the telemetry lap is not clean. valid 1 follows a write that makes the record valid (+0xd8 = +0xe0 & 1), with lap = the current index + 1 (wrapping at 200): the .data1 bodies 0x14d4f3ad0 (thunk 0x142924700, at 0x14d4f3b9c and 0x14d4f3c28) and 0x14d4f4540 (at 0x14d4f45ba and 0x14d4f4631), and Game_PracticeProgrammeSystem_BindCompareLap at 0x142941328 when the telemetry lap is clean. Steam 1.0.145 thunk 0x142f2e330 (body 0x14f2ef320) and EA 1.0.145 0x142f22310 (body 0x14e2d8060, restored dump): aligned 75 of 76 instructions, the port adds one protector store to a global in the log gate; +0x78/+0x90/+0x101 at the same places.
